description: Create the Google Apps Script backend (Code.gs) and PWA infrastructure files (manifest.json, sw.js). Code.gs serves the main HTML app and provides endpoints for manifest and service worker. This is the foundation that all other features build upon.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/timestamp/Code.gs with: doGet() function that serves index.html via HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile(), include() helper function for file inclusion, doGetManifest() or web app routing to serve manifest.json and sw.js content

Create /projects/sandbox/timestamp/manifest.json as a valid PWA manifest with: name 'TrustMark', short_name 'TrustMark', theme_color '#1B3A5C', background_color '#1B3A5C', display 'standalone', orientation 'portrait', start_url '.', icons array (generate simple placeholder icon references), categories ['photography', 'utilities']

Create /projects/sandbox/timestamp/sw.js service worker with: install event that caches the app shell (CDN libraries: piexifjs, leaflet, qrcode), fetch event with cache-first strategy for CDN resources and network-first for app content, activate event to clean old caches
acceptance_criteria: Code.gs contains a valid doGet() function that returns HtmlService output
Code.gs has an include() function for template inclusion
manifest.json is valid JSON with all required PWA fields
sw.js implements install, fetch, and activate event handlers
sw.js caches CDN resources for offline use
verification: Run: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const code=fs.readFileSync('/projects/sandbox/timestamp/sw.js','utf8'); if(code.includes('install') && code.includes('fetch') && code.includes('activate')) console.log('sw.js valid'); else process.exit(1)"
